[[File:YinchorriShieldRozess-ActsOfWar2.jpg|thumb|Raid on the Jedi Temple, outside a rooftop entrance.]]
{{Quote|That, student, is a cortosis shield. They're very rare, and, as you can understand, we're not anxious for that to change.|[[Micah Giiett]] to [[K'Kruhk]]|<ref name="Jedi Council: Acts of War 1">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 1|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 1]]</ref>}}
A '''cortosis shield''' was a piece of protective equipment created from [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis ore]]. It came in many different varieties, like [[Vambrace/Legends|armguards]]. Since the impurities of the ore were removed, they were as good at repelling [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] as [[Cortosis-weave|cortosis weave]] armor. Like cortosis weave, a lightsaber impact against the substance would shut off a lightsaber. The lightsaber would then have to restart in order for it to work properly.

[[Darth Desolous]] and his army of [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] soldiers used cortosis alloy shields in countless battles. With this weapon Desolous and his army [[Darth Desolous conflict|slaughtered]] a countless multitude of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

The [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] used these shields during their [[Raid on the Jedi Temple (Yinchorri Uprising)|raid]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Despite their cortosis shields, the attack force was slaughtered by the Jedi with only two Jedi fatalities.<ref name="Acts of War 2">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 2]]</ref>
